title: DDoS protection coverage audit
description: Identifies VNets hosting public-facing workloads without DDoS Protection Standard enabled.
example_prompt: "List all VNets containing subnets with public IP addresses or Application Gateways. Check whether DDoS Protection Standard is enabled on each VNet. Flag VNets with public-facing resources but no DDoS protection. Show VNet name, public resource count, and estimated DDoS plan cost."
